thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] hosted-api queue growth detected in us-east-1. queued_requests=11,800, p95=2.1s->18s, p99=48s, error_rate(5m)=3.4%. autoscaler attempted scale but hit capacity limit. paging infra-oncall.
Maya (sre): paging received — I'm on it. ticket=#INC-4521. grabbing logs + metrics.
Ravi (infra-oncall): seeing provisioner 429s and InstanceCreateTimeouts in the last 2m. GPU pool for hosted-dedicated-us-east at limit (quota cap).
Maya (sre): confirm autoscaler pushed nodes but cloud quota blocked new GPU allocations. provisioning error: `QuotaExceeded.GPUs` in provisioner logs.
Ryan (eng-lead): any customer-facing throttles or 503s? Julia (support): several customer alerts about timeouts and slow responses; CS triage opening.
Maya (sre): current tactic: 1) enable degraded routing to small-quantized model variant for non-critical routes, 2) flip rate-limit to 80% on bursty API key allowlist, 3) route eligible requests to eu-west instead of us-east. executing now.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: `feature/deg-routing-quick` -> staged. watch for errors.
Ravi (infra-oncall): routing rule updated, ~40% of traffic shifted to eu-west proxy. queue in us-east dropped from 11.8k -> 4.9k last 3m. good.
Elena (capacity): I can request emergency capacity bump but cloud lead needs approval; starting support ticket with quota team now. ETA ~30-60m.
Maya (sre): autoscaler logs show scale-down suppressed earlier due to cooldown flags; we had hysteresis mismatch — will patch to lower cooldown for this class.
Ryan (eng-lead): any workarounds short-term? can we evict low-priority batch jobs from pools?
Ravi (infra-oncall): evicting batch jobs from shared GPU pool now. freed 6 GPUs, immediate p95 improved to ~6s.
Julia (support): notifying top affected customers: 4 enterprise tenants saw elevated latencies, one reported timeouts leading to 429 client retries. sending interim status update.
Maya (sre): observed retry storms from some clients — enabling smart backoff at edge for repeated 429s. added `X-Rate-Reason` header in responses for tracing.
deploy-bot: canary shows healthy for deg-routing; no spike in errors for eu-west.
Elena (capacity): quota ticket acknowledged by cloud provider; they can grant +10 GPUs for 45m window, pending internal approval.
Maya (sre): plan: keep degraded routing + partial rate-limits, evict noncritical workloads, accept temporary quota bump if approved, reduce autoscaler cooldown, monitor p99.
Ravi (infra-oncall): implemented cooldown patch (lowered from 300s -> 90s) for hosted-backed pools. will watch for oscillation.
Maya (sre): metrics now p95 ~3.8s, p99 ~12s, queued ~1.2k. still degraded but customer impact contained.
Ryan (eng-lead): good triage. assign follow-ups: 1) postmortem owner (Maya), 2) quota playbook update (Elena), 3) autoscaler config audit (Ryan).
Julia (support): posted status to affected customers and support channel; continuing to escalate any new outages.
Maya (sre): handing off to Ravi for night coverage — leaving runbook notes + checklist in incident ticket. next check-in in 30m.
Ravi (infra-oncall): taking handoff. will maintain mitigations and coordinate with capacity team. @Elena keep me posted on quota approval.
Elena (capacity): cloud approved +10 GPUs for 45m, applying now.
Maya (sre): thanks team — marking incident as "mitigated" for customer-facing comms but keeping pagers live until metrics stable for 30m. action items logged. postmortem to follow. :thumbsup:
